title: TRIZ principle 5 — merging
problem_statement: Separate operations waste time and handling. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Merge identical or similar operations: multicore processors, combine harvesters, all-in-one printers. Do in parallel what was serial. Constraint emphasis: the listed constraints are the design drivers — solve the hardest one first.
novelty_assessment: Consolidation as invention rather than laziness.
constraints: Failure of the merged unit kills all functions
validation_plan: Time the separate vs merged operations
Failure-mode analysis of the merged design
